---
title: "Arena mode level normalization"
type: learnings
description: "PvP arena normalizes hero levels; the team builder still rewards raw artifact levels there"
project: gamehelper
tags: [arena, normalization]
---

Arena puts every hero on a shared level baseline before a fight, so raw investment buys
nothing there. Artifact levels are not normalized by the arena, and the team builder has to
score them on their own scale or it overvalues heavily upgraded artifacts.
